methods.title: Regional reference values: Vickery and Quinn (2023)
methods.reference: Vickery, C. E., and Quinn, J. E. (2023), Environmental Management 72:1216-1227, Appendix 1, DOI:10.1007/s00267-023-01861-6.

axes.reference: DOI:10.1007/s00267-023-01861-6, Appendix 1; NDR nitrogen subsurface length=200 m.
DOI:10.1007/s00267-023-01861-6, Appendix 1; NDR nitrogen subsurface efficiency=0.8.
DOI:10.1007/s00267-023-01861-6, Appendix 1; SDR maximum delivery ratio=0.8.

notes: These are the published Appendix 1 reference defaults used where regionally specific parameter values were unavailable. They are single reference values, not uncertainty ranges or locally calibrated Upper Savannah coefficients.

Each axis has one value. Factorial design applies the eight published scalars jointly as one candidate configuration; the experiment also retains its original baseline profile and deduplicates an identical candidate.
Use these axes with the selected study's actual baseline run, complete grid, retained alternative scenarios and biophysical table. The preset does not replace those selections.
The experiment engine generates axis variants from the selected baseline profile. Additional retained profiles keep their own source tables and parameters.
The published phosphorus subsurface defaults are omitted because native InVEST 3.20.0 models subsurface nutrient transfer for nitrogen.

Flow-direction choices, runoff-proxy average, SDR l_max and biophysical coefficients remain those of the selected actual baseline profile because this source table does not supply reference values for them.
At 30 m, a threshold of 1000 contributing pixels corresponds to 900000 square metres, or 90 hectares. Treat the parameter as an upstream-cell threshold on the selected grid.
If all table rows allocate zero nitrogen to subsurface flow, the nitrogen subsurface length and efficiency axes are inactive for that profile.

The DOI source establishes the scalar references. Native support is established by the fixed InVEST 3.20.0 NDR and SDR implementations: https://github.com/natcap/invest/blob/3.20.0/src/natcap/invest/ndr/ndr.py and https://github.com/natcap/invest/blob/3.20.0/src/natcap/invest/sdr/sdr.py.
Land-cover prescriptions from the paper can inform separately documented scenarios. The current preset changes numeric parameters only; it preserves the study's actual retained alternatives.
